description: Current Bank of Israel representative exchange rate for a single currency vs the Israeli Shekel (ILS), by 3-letter ISO code. Returns currentExchangeRate (shekels per `unit`), currentChange (%), unit, and lastUpdate. Note `unit` (e.g. JPY is per 100). Example keys: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD.
name: boi_exchange_rate
title: Boi Exchange Rate
